Major Requirements scrape-majors.js

Scrapes undergraduate degree requirements from catalog.northeastern.edu and writes parsed.initial.json files in the Major2 schema. This is nu-map's own scraper — a ground-up replacement for the stale external/graduatenu submodule data (since removed) that was missing writing requirements for ~45% of combined/joint programs.

Script
scripts/scrape-majors.js
Output
src/data/majors/{year}/{college}/{slug}/parsed.initial.json
Rate limit
600 ms between requests (override: MAJORS_DELAY_MS=300)
Duration
~45 minutes for all programs. Run --dry-run (first 5 programs) for a sanity check.

What it scrapes

Starting from catalog.northeastern.edu/azindex/, it discovers all undergraduate program pages, then visits each to extract the requirement tree. The output structure matches the Major2 schema used by the graduation requirement evaluator:

  • SECTION nodes: named requirement groups (e.g. "Core Requirements", "NUpath Requirements")
  • COURSE nodes: specific courses
  • OR / AND nodes: choice or conjunction of courses
  • XOM nodes: "X of many" — choose at least N credits from a list
  • RANGE nodes: all courses in a subject range (e.g. CS 3000–3999)

Output path structure

src/data/majors/
  2026/
    khoury/
      computer_science_bscs_(boston)/
        parsed.initial.json
      computer_science_and_mathematics_bscs/
        parsed.initial.json
    engineering/
      electrical_engineering_bsee/
        parsed.initial.json
    ...

The path slug is derived from the program title: lowercased, commas removed, spaces replaced with underscores. The year tag defaults to the current calendar year but can be overridden with --year 2025.

When to run

The scraped files in src/data/majors/ are the sole source of requirement data — the old external/graduatenu submodule (~1,400 major files scraped by the GraduateNU team) has been removed. Run the Major Requirements adapter when:

  • A new catalog year is published (Jan or May)
  • A program's requirements have changed and the scraped data is stale

Change log entry

A successful --write run appends to change-log.json:

{
  "type": "majors",
  "subject": "🎓 Major Requirements",
  "timestamp": "2026-05-19T10:00:00.000Z",
  "done": 312,
  "written": 298,
  "skipped": 10,
  "failed": 4
}

done = programs attempted. written = files written. skipped = already up to date. failed = parse or fetch errors (check stdout for details).

Usage

node scripts/scrape-majors.js               # preview (no writes)
node scripts/scrape-majors.js --dry-run     # first 5 programs only (fast sanity check)
node scripts/scrape-majors.js --write       # write all output files (~45 min)
node scripts/scrape-majors.js --url <url>  # single program URL
node scripts/scrape-majors.js --year 2025  # override year tag in output path

Via the Trigger tab: ▷ Preview streams the dry-run output. ⚡ Run locally writes all files and logs a manual-trigger entry. Expect the SSE stream to run for ~45 minutes on a full write.
